content.text:
Found the blocker: the forge.ko.ag OAuth credential helper is broken — `fj whoami` returns `token was already used` (refresh-token reuse rejected server-side), not just an expired/transient token. This blocks 2 inputs (`dotfiles-private`, `ssh-oidc`) that live on forge.ko.ag. `fj auth list` still shows logged in, so the stored refresh token itself needs to be replaced, which means a login flow — I won't run `fj auth login` myself since that's an external auth action tied to your account.

I'll update everything else now and flag this separately.
